key_insight: MOTIF improves out-of-distribution materials property prediction by using LLMs to propose chemical taxonomies rather than predict numerical properties directly.
engineering_relevance: Taxonomy-guided feature selection can make property models more robust when screening materials with chemistries beyond the training distribution.
method: Generate candidate material taxonomies with LLMs.
Retain taxonomies that improve training-only pseudo-OOD validation.
Apply invariant feature selection within each taxonomy and gated aggregation across taxonomies.
evidence_signal: On 2D halide perovskites, mean OOD bandgap MAE fell from 0.122 to 0.111 eV; frozen dev/test evaluation also showed smaller gains for electronic and optical bandgaps, with transfer evaluated on additional materials datasets.
watch_item: Taxonomy selection depends on pseudo-OOD validation, whose shifts may not represent genuinely novel deployment chemistries.
paper_title: MOTIF: LLM-Defined Material Taxonomies for OOD Property Prediction via Invariant Feature Selection
